description: Plate geometry for the site: Plate I (Galle's night, 1846 Sep 23) and Plate II (the 1821 Uranus-planet conjunction). Built by docs/notes/scripts/m7_plates.py.
frame: heliocentric (Sun + inner-planet barycentre), projected onto the ecliptic of date of each plate's epoch; x toward that date's equinox; AU
posterior: M6c replacement posterior, 6000 derived samples (as m6c_conjunction.py); stipple: seeded subsample of 600 (rng 20261109)
checks: conjunction-longitude quantiles reproduce m6c_conjunction.json and Galle-night geocentric quantiles reproduce m6c_repeat.json's reported interval, to 1e-3 deg

sources.jpl: JPL Horizons (cache): Neptune's position and the Uranus and Neptune paths
sources.uranus_fit: Uranus at the plate epoch: median of the posterior samples' modelled positions
sources.orbit_paths: JPL paths over the cached epochs; Le Verrier's ellipse over one period from his 1846 elements

plate_ii_conjunction.angle_magnification_rule: angles about SC drawn x K, radii to scale; K = smallest of [1, 2, 5, 10, 20] with K x |L - C| >= 10.0 deg
